title: 2_b_r_0_2_b__vonnegut
author: Vonnegut, Kurt
summary: In a future utopia where death is voluntary to keep the population stable, a man whose wife has just delivered triplets must find three volunteers to die; unable to face killing his grandfather, he shoots a doctor, a gas-chamber hostess, and himself to make room for his children, leaving a despairing painter to book his own termination.
